title: Interlock Heatmap + Action List (April 2025)
content:
Purpose: lightweight cross-team heatmap and actionable runbook to surface operational friction points blocking Q2 SLAs and product rollouts. Use this as the single ad-hoc reference for weekly ops sync.

CSV table (columns: Priority,Domain,Symptom,Severity(1-5),Estimated-users-impacted,Weekly-incidents,Root-cause-hypothesis,Owner,Immediate-mitigation,ETA-days,Blockers,Notes):
P0,Serving-runtime,Periodic 500s on short sequences,5,~1k req/day,4,KV-cache eviction under high concurrent traffic causing memory thrash,Liam Chen,Force smaller batch windows + temporary autoscale rule,2,Capacity gating config in prod,ENG-2341 shows similar repro
P0,Console,Dashboard panels time out for heavy accounts,5,15 enterprise accounts,6,Query fanout + unoptimized joins on metric store,Sofia Martinez,Add quick caching layer + increase query timeout,5,Need approvals for DB read replicas,Linked to INF-112
P1,Dedicated,Throughput variance on reserved pools,4,~3 teams daily,3,Autoscaler misread of GPU utilization under mixed workloads,Rajesh Iyer,Apply conservative lower bound for target replicas,3,Long QA for autoscaler changes,PR in runtime repo pending
P1,Private-deployments,Authentication errors during key rotation,4,2 customers,2,KMS rotation script race condition,Kimberly Wu,Revert to previous rotation schedule + manual rotate,1,Coord with customer SOC,Ops runbook drafted
P2,Observability,Span sampling drops at peak,3,internal only,8,Sampling policy tied to request tags that are stripped upstream,Observability team,Short-term: increase sample rate,7,Need SDK patch to preserve tags,github PR #412
P2,SDKs,Python SDK intermittent serialization bug,3,50 devs,5,Edge case with streaming fallback,Developer Experience,Pin SDK to last stable; add instrumentation,4,Release windows and client adoption time required
P3,Billing,Unexpected billing spike for embeddings,2,internal + a few customers,1,Double-counting on retry path,Billing Ops,Temporarily throttle embedding retries,1,Requires reconciliation script
P3,Platform-engineering,Infra patch backlog causing security drift,2,company-wide,0,Patch pipeline stalled on one image,Platform Eng,Emergency image rebuild,2,None besides CI flakiness

Heatmap summary: 2 P0 items, 2 P1 items, 4 P2/P3 items. Immediate focus this week: Serving-runtime P0 + Console P0.

Quick KPIs (rolling 7d):
- Average 95th latency change (serving-runtime): +14% vs baseline
- Weekly customer-facing incidents: 3 (2 P0, 1 P1)
- Token cost deviation leading to billing spike: +6% (embedding retry path)

Action/owners short list (one-liners):
- Liam Chen: implement temporary batch-window clamp and monitor for 48h (done by 2025-04-17).
- Sofia Martinez: enable dashboard cache + raise DB replica request to infra (request id: INF-260).
- Rajesh Iyer: test autoscaler conservative policy in staging and coordinate canary rollout (ENG-2472).
- Kimberly Wu: coordinate customer key rotation rollback and SOC sync (contact: security-oncall).
- Observability: prioritize SDK tag-preservation PR for merge (PR #412).
- Billing Ops: run reconciliation and pause embedding retry job until fix validated.

Open questions and decisions needed:
- Do we keep the batch-window clamp as a permanent safety? (ops sync decision)
- DB read-replica approval: finance vs infra cost split?
- Customer communication cadence for private-deploy key rotation incidents.

Meeting cadence and owners:
- Weekly ops interlock (Mon 09:30 PDT) owner: Maya Patel
- P0 standups (daily until resolved) owner: respective P0 owners listed above

Notes on data sources and reproducibility:
- Incident counts from PagerDuty exported 2025-04-09 to 2025-04-15
- Latency metrics from Datadog dashboards (serving-runtime: dd:svc.latency.95)
- Billing spike analysis draft: sheets link (internal, redacted) and BillingOps reconciliation ticket: JIRA INF-198

Next steps (this doc):
1) Owners to update ETA and blockers inline by EOD Fri 2025-04-18.
2) Maya to consolidate resolution notes and mark items closed in next edition.
3) Convert top 2 P0 mitigations into runbook playbooks and attach to PagerDuty response.

Quick contact list:
- Slack: #ops-interlock (primary)
- PagerDuty: ops-oncall
- Confluence: /display/OPS/Interlock-Playbooks (reference)

Revision history:
- 2025-04-10 created by Maya Patel (initial heatmap)
- 2025-04-12 updated with console P0 telemetry and tentative mitigations
- 2025-04-15 added SDK/observability row and linked PRs

Use guidance: keep this doc lightweight; when an item graduates to a multi-day remediation with cross-team commits, spin a dedicated tracking ticket and remove here (this is intentionally ephemeral).
